#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Direction R: DeBERTa NLI Verifier for ProofWriter-D5 (600 questions)
Replicates FOLIO R experiment on ProofWriter to strengthen statistical evidence.
SC/SICA baselines from exp046_mistral_7b_pw600.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from collections import Counter
from scipy.stats import binomtest
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
import torch

PW_DATA_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/proofwriter_full.json"
EXP046_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/exp046_mistral_7b_pw600/exp046_results.json"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/direction_r_nli_pw600"
MODEL_NAME = "/root/models/deberta-large-mnli"
CLASSES = ["True", "False", "Unknown"]


def parse_problem(problem_text):
    marker = "\n\nDetermine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:\n"
    if marker in problem_text:
        parts = problem_text.split(marker, 1)
        premises = parts[0].strip()
        conclusion = parts[1].strip()
    else:
        premises = problem_text
        conclusion = ""
    return premises, conclusion


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=0, help="Limit to first N questions (0=all)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    with open(PW_DATA_PATH) as f:
        pw_data = json.load(f)
    with open(EXP046_PATH) as f:
        exp046 = json.load(f)

    exp046_by_id = {r["problem_id"]: r for r in exp046["results"]}

    gt = {q["id"]: q["answer"] for q in pw_data}
    if args.n > 0:
        pw_data = pw_data[:args.n]
        gt = {q["id"]: q["answer"] for q in pw_data}

    total = len(gt)
    print(f"Dataset: {total} questions")

    # SC and SICA answers from exp046
    sc_answers = {}
    sica_answers = {}
    sc_vote_dists = {}
    for qid in gt:
        r = exp046_by_id.get(qid)
        if r:
            sc_answers[qid] = r["sc_answer"]
            sica_answers[qid] = r["sica_answer"]
            sc_vote_dists[qid] = r.get("sc_vote_distribution", {})
        else:
            sc_answers[qid] = None
            sica_answers[qid] = None
            sc_vote_dists[qid] = {}

    sc_correct_n = sum(1 for qid in gt if sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    sc_acc = sc_correct_n / total
    sica_correct_n = sum(1 for qid in gt if sica_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    sica_acc = sica_correct_n / total
    print(f"SC baseline: {sc_acc:.4f} ({sc_correct_n}/{total})")
    print(f"SICA baseline: {sica_acc:.4f} ({sica_correct_n}/{total})")

    # Load DeBERTa
    print(f"\nLoading {MODEL_NAME}...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    model.eval()

    id2label = model.config.id2label
    print(f"Label mapping: {id2label}")
    nli_to_pw = {}
    for idx, label in id2label.items():
        lu = label.upper()
        if "ENTAIL" in lu:
            nli_to_pw[idx] = "True"
        elif "CONTRA" in lu:
            nli_to_pw[idx] = "False"
        else:
            nli_to_pw[idx] = "Unknown"
    print(f"NLI->PW: {nli_to_pw}")

    # === DeBERTa standalone ===
    print("\n=== DeBERTa standalone ===")
    deberta_preds = {}

            continue

        inputs = tokenizer(premises, conclusion, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(**inputs)

        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)[0]
        pred_idx = probs.argmax().item()
        pred_label = nli_to_pw[pred_idx]

        deberta_preds[qid] = pred_label
        deberta_probs[qid] = {nli_to_pw[k]: round(probs[k].item(), 4) for k in nli_to_pw}

        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0 or (i + 1) == len(pw_data):
            print(f"  Processed {i+1}/{len(pw_data)}")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"  Inference: {elapsed:.1f}s for {len(pw_data)} questions")

    deberta_correct_n = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    deberta_acc = deberta_correct_n / total
    print(f"  DeBERTa accuracy: {deberta_acc:.4f} ({deberta_correct_n}/{total})")

    # Per-class breakdown for DeBERTa
    per_class = {}
    for cls in CLASSES:
        ids_cls = [qid for qid in gt if gt[qid] == cls]
        n_cls = len(ids_cls)
        tp = sum(1 for qid in ids_cls if deberta_preds.get(qid) == cls)
        fp = sum(1 for qid in gt if gt[qid] != cls and deberta_preds.get(qid) == cls)
        fn = n_cls - tp
        p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
        r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
        f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0
        per_class[cls] = {
            "n": n_cls, "correct": tp,
            "accuracy": round(tp / n_cls, 4) if n_cls > 0 else 0,
            "precision": round(p, 4), "recall": round(r, 4), "f1": round(f1, 4)
        }
    print(f"  Per-class: { {c: per_class[c]['accuracy'] for c in CLASSES} }")

    gt_dist = dict(Counter(gt.values()))
    pred_dist = dict(Counter(deberta_preds.values()))

    # === Complementarity analysis ===
    print("\n=== Complementarity ===")
    nli_right_sc_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    sc_right_nli_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid] and deberta_preds.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    both_right = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    both_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) != gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    print(f"  NLI correct & SC wrong: {nli_right_sc_wrong}")
    print(f"  SC correct & NLI wrong: {sc_right_nli_wrong}")
    print(f"  Both correct: {both_right}")
    print(f"  Both wrong: {both_wrong}")

    # === Combo: DeBERTa vote added to SC votes ===
    print("\n=== Combo (DeBERTa + SC votes) ===")
    combo_results = {}
    for weight in [1, 3]:
        combo_correct = 0
        combo_preds = {}
        # McNemar: b = SC correct & combo wrong, c = SC wrong & combo correct
        b_count = 0
        c_count = 0
        for qid in gt:
            gold = gt[qid]
            dist = sc_vote_dists.get(qid, {})
            votes = Counter()
            for label, count in dist.items():
                if label in CLASSES:
                    votes[label] += count

            dp = deberta_preds.get(qid)
            if dp in CLASSES:
                votes[dp] += weight

            combo_answer = votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else "Unknown"
            combo_preds[qid] = combo_answer

            if combo_answer == gold:
                combo_correct += 1

            sc_is_correct = (sc_answers.get(qid) == gold)
            combo_is_correct = (combo_answer == gold)
            if sc_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                b_count += 1
            if not sc_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                c_count += 1

        combo_acc = combo_correct / total
        delta = combo_acc - sc_acc
        n_disc = b_count + c_count
        p_val = binomtest(min(b_count, c_count), n_disc, 0.5).pvalue if n_disc > 0 else 1.0

        combo_results[weight] = {
            "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
            "correct": combo_correct,
            "delta_vs_sc": round(delta, 4),
            "delta_pp": round(delta * 100, 2),
            "mcnemar_b": b_count,
            "mcnemar_c": c_count,
            "mcnemar_n_discordant": n_disc,
            "mcnemar_p": round(p_val, 6)
        }
        sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else ""
        print(f"  w={weight}: acc={combo_acc:.4f} ({combo_correct}/{total}), "
              f"delta={delta:+.4f} ({delta*100:+.2f}pp), "
              f"McNemar b={b_count} c={c_count} p={p_val:.4f} {sig}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R11 Q3: 3-verifier BH analysis using canonical NLI predictions.

Loads DeBERTa per-question data from D116, runs RoBERTa/BART inference
using canonical models already on server, computes individual + ensemble
combos, McNemar tests, and BH correction.

Canonical expectations (from nli_multi_verifier_recomputed.json):
  SC baseline: 39.33% (236/600) [alphabetical tiebreaking]
  DeBERTa-large standalone: 55.0% (330/600)
  RoBERTa-large standalone: 37.67% (226/600)
  BART-large standalone: 46.17% (277/600)
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import torch
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from scipy.stats import binomtest
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

PW_DATA = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/proofwriter_full.json"
SC_VOTES = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/mistral_pw600_sc_votes.json"
D116_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/d116_qwen3_pw_deberta_large/results.json"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/r11_3verifier_canonical.json"

MODELS = {
    "DeBERTa-large-MNLI": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/deberta-large-mnli",
    "RoBERTa-large-MNLI": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-large-mnli",
    "BART-large-MNLI": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/bart-large-mnli",
}

CLASSES = ["True", "False", "Unknown"]
WEIGHTS = [1, 3, 5]

CANONICAL_STANDALONE = {
    "DeBERTa-large-MNLI": (0.55, 330),
    "RoBERTa-large-MNLI": (0.3767, 226),
    "BART-large-MNLI": (0.4617, 277),
}


def map_nli_label(label_str):
    lu = label_str.upper()
    if "ENTAIL" in lu:
        return "True"
    if "CONTRA" in lu:
        return "False"
    return "Unknown"


def parse_problem(problem_text):
    for marker in [
        "\n\nDetermine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:\n",
        "Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:",
        "Determine whether the following statement is True, False, or Unknown:",
    ]:
        if marker in problem_text:
            parts = problem_text.split(marker, 1)
            return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
    return problem_text, ""


def sc_answer_alpha(votes_dict):
    """SC answer with alphabetical tiebreaking."""
    if not votes_dict:
        return None
    max_count = max(votes_dict.values())
    tied = [c for c in CLASSES if votes_dict.get(c, 0) == max_count]
    return sorted(tied)[0]


def combo_answer_alpha(sc_votes, nli_probs, w):
    """Combo: SC votes + w * NLI probs, alphabetical tiebreaking."""
    combined = {}
    for c in CLASSES:
        combined[c] = sc_votes.get(c, 0) + w * nli_probs.get(c, 0.0)
    max_score = max(combined.values())
    tied = [c for c in CLASSES if abs(combined[c] - max_score) < 1e-9]
    return sorted(tied)[0]


def ensemble_combo_answer_alpha(sc_votes, nli_probs_list, w):
    """3-verifier ensemble: SC votes + w * avg(NLI probs), alphabetical tiebreaking."""
    n_verifiers = len(nli_probs_list)
    combined = {}
    for c in CLASSES:
        avg_prob = sum(p.get(c, 0.0) for p in nli_probs_list) / n_verifiers
        combined[c] = sc_votes.get(c, 0) + w * avg_prob
    max_score = max(combined.values())
    tied = [c for c in CLASSES if abs(combined[c] - max_score) < 1e-9]
    return sorted(tied)[0]


def mcnemar_exact_2sided(b, c):
    """McNemar exact test. b=SC_right&combo_wrong, c=SC_wrong&combo_right."""
    n = b + c
    if n == 0:
        return 1.0
    return binomtest(min(b, c), n, 0.5).pvalue


def bh_correction(p_values):
    """Benjamini-Hochberg correction."""
    n = len(p_values)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    ranked_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: p_values[i])
    adjusted = [0.0] * n
    for rank_idx, orig_idx in enumerate(ranked_indices):
        adjusted[orig_idx] = p_values[orig_idx] * n / (rank_idx + 1)
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        idx_curr = ranked_indices[i]
        idx_next = ranked_indices[i + 1]
        adjusted[idx_curr] = min(adjusted[idx_curr], adjusted[idx_next])
    return [min(p, 1.0) for p in adjusted]


def run_nli_inference(model_name, model_path, pw_data, device):
    """Run NLI inference, return per-question predictions and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Loading {model_name}: {model_path}")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(model_path)
    model.to(device)
    model.eval()

    id2label = model.config.id2label
    nli_to_pw = {int(k): map_nli_label(v) for k, v in id2label.items()}
    print(f"  id2label: {id2label}")
    print(f"  nli_to_pw: {nli_to_pw}")

    preds = {}
    probs_all = {}
    t0 = time.time()

    for i, q in enumerate(pw_data):
        qid = q["id"]
        premises, conclusion = parse_problem(q["problem"])
        if not conclusion:
            preds[qid] = "Unknown"
            probs_all[qid] = {"True": 0.0, "False": 0.0, "Unknown": 1.0}
            continue

        inputs = tokenizer(premises, conclusion, return_tensors="pt",
                           truncation=True, max_length=512).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**inputs).logits
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)[0]

        prob_dict = {}
        for idx in nli_to_pw:
            label = nli_to_pw[idx]
            if label in prob_dict:
                prob_dict[label] += probs[idx].item()
            else:
                prob_dict[label] = probs[idx].item()

        for c in CLASSES:
            prob_dict.setdefault(c, 0.0)
        probs_all[qid] = {c: round(prob_dict[c], 6) for c in CLASSES}
        preds[qid] = max(CLASSES, key=lambda x: prob_dict.get(x, 0))

        if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
            print(f"  {i+1}/{len(pw_data)} ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s)")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"  Done: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return preds, probs_all


def main():
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    print(f"Device: {device}")

    # Load data
    with open(PW_DATA) as f:
        pw_data = json.load(f)
    with open(SC_VOTES) as f:
        sc_votes_raw = json.load(f)

    gt = {q["id"]: q["answer"] for q in pw_data}
    pids = sorted(gt.keys())
    n = len(pids)
    print(f"Dataset: {n} questions")

    # Parse SC votes: [True, False, Unknown] -> dict
    sc_votes = {}
    for pid in pids:
        v = sc_votes_raw.get(pid, [0, 0, 0])
        sc_votes[pid] = {"True": v[0], "False": v[1], "Unknown": v[2]}

    # SC baseline with alphabetical tiebreaking
    sc_answers = {pid: sc_answer_alpha(sc_votes[pid]) for pid in pids}
    sc_correct = {pid: (sc_answers[pid] == gt[pid]) for pid in pids}
    sc_n_correct = sum(sc_correct.values())
    sc_acc = sc_n_correct / n
    print(f"SC baseline: {sc_n_correct}/{n} = {sc_acc:.4f} ({sc_acc*100:.2f}%)")
    assert sc_n_correct == 236, f"SC baseline mismatch: {sc_n_correct} != 236"

    # === Phase 1: Load DeBERTa predictions from D116 ===
    print("\n=== Loading DeBERTa predictions from D116 (no re-inference) ===")
    with open(D116_PATH) as f:
        d116 = json.load(f)

    deberta_probs = {}
    deberta_preds = {}
    for pid, qdata in d116["per_question"].items():
        deberta_preds[pid] = qdata["deberta_pred"]
        deberta_probs[pid] = {c: qdata["deberta_probs"].get(c, 0.0) for c in CLASSES}

    deberta_correct_n = sum(1 for pid in pids if deberta_preds.get(pid) == gt[pid])
    print(f"  DeBERTa standalone: {deberta_correct_n}/{n} = {deberta_correct_n/n:.4f}")
    exp_acc, exp_n = CANONICAL_STANDALONE["DeBERTa-large-MNLI"]
    assert deberta_correct_n == exp_n, f"DeBERTa standalone mismatch: {deberta_correct_n} != {exp_n}"
    print(f"  ✓ Matches canonical ({exp_n})")

    # === Phase 2: Run RoBERTa and BART inference ===
    all_verifier_probs = {"DeBERTa-large-MNLI": deberta_probs}
    all_verifier_preds = {"DeBERTa-large-MNLI": deberta_preds}

    for model_name in ["RoBERTa-large-MNLI", "BART-large-MNLI"]:
        model_path = MODELS[model_name]
        preds, probs = run_nli_inference(model_name, model_path, pw_data, device)
        all_verifier_preds[model_name] = preds
        all_verifier_probs[model_name] = probs

        correct_n = sum(1 for pid in pids if preds.get(pid) == gt[pid])
        exp_acc, exp_n = CANONICAL_STANDALONE[model_name]
        print(f"  {model_name} standalone: {correct_n}/{n} = {correct_n/n:.4f}")
        if correct_n != exp_n:
            print(f"  ⚠ WARNING: expected {exp_n}, got {correct_n}")
        else:
            print(f"  ✓ Matches canonical ({exp_n})")

    # === Phase 3: Compute individual verifier combos ===
    print("\n=== Computing individual verifier combos ===")

    all_tests = []  # (label, raw_p)
    per_verifier_results = {}

    for vname in ["DeBERTa-large-MNLI", "RoBERTa-large-MNLI", "BART-large-MNLI"]:
        vprobs = all_verifier_probs[vname]
        vpreds = all_verifier_preds[vname]

        standalone_n = sum(1 for pid in pids if vpreds.get(pid) == gt[pid])
        standalone_acc = standalone_n / n

        combo_results = {}
        for w in WEIGHTS:
            combo_answers = {}
            b_count = 0  # SC right, combo wrong
            c_count = 0  # SC wrong, combo right

            for pid in pids:
                ca = combo_answer_alpha(sc_votes[pid], vprobs.get(pid, {}), w)
                combo_answers[pid] = ca
                combo_is_correct = (ca == gt[pid])
                sc_is_correct = sc_correct[pid]
                if sc_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                    b_count += 1
                if not sc_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                    c_count += 1

            combo_n_correct = sum(1 for pid in pids if combo_answers[pid] == gt[pid])
            combo_acc = combo_n_correct / n
            delta_pp = round((combo_acc - sc_acc) * 100, 2)
            p_val = mcnemar_exact_2sided(b_count, c_count)

            combo_results[f"w{w}"] = {
                "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
                "correct": combo_n_correct,
                "delta_pp": delta_pp,
                "mcnemar_b": b_count,
                "mcnemar_c": c_count,
                "mcnemar_p": p_val,
            }
            all_tests.append((f"{vname}_w{w}", p_val))

            sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else ""
            print(f"  {vname} w={w}: {combo_acc:.4f} ({combo_n_correct}), "
                  f"Δ={delta_pp:+.2f}pp, b={b_count} c={c_count} p={p_val:.6f} {sig}")

        per_verifier_results[vname] = {
            "standalone_acc": round(standalone_acc, 4),
            "standalone_correct": standalone_n,
            "combo": combo_results,
        }

    # === Phase 4: Compute 3-verifier ensemble combo ===
    print("\n=== Computing 3-verifier ensemble combo ===")

    ensemble_results = {}
    verifier_names = ["DeBERTa-large-MNLI", "RoBERTa-large-MNLI", "BART-large-MNLI"]

    for w in WEIGHTS:
        b_count = 0
        c_count = 0
        combo_answers = {}

        for pid in pids:
            probs_list = [all_verifier_probs[v].get(pid, {}) for v in verifier_names]
            ca = ensemble_combo_answer_alpha(sc_votes[pid], probs_list, w)
            combo_answers[pid] = ca
            combo_is_correct = (ca == gt[pid])
            sc_is_correct = sc_correct[pid]
            if sc_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                b_count += 1
            if not sc_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                c_count += 1

        combo_n_correct = sum(1 for pid in pids if combo_answers[pid] == gt[pid])
        combo_acc = combo_n_correct / n
        delta_pp = round((combo_acc - sc_acc) * 100, 2)
        p_val = mcnemar_exact_2sided(b_count, c_count)

        ensemble_results[f"w{w}"] = {
            "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
            "correct": combo_n_correct,
            "delta_pp": delta_pp,
            "mcnemar_b": b_count,
            "mcnemar_c": c_count,
            "mcnemar_p": p_val,
        }
        all_tests.append((f"ensemble_3v_w{w}", p_val))

        sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else ""
        print(f"  Ensemble w={w}: {combo_acc:.4f} ({combo_n_correct}), "
              f"Δ={delta_pp:+.2f}pp, b={b_count} c={c_count} p={p_val:.6f} {sig}")

    # === Phase 5: BH correction ===
    print("\n=== BH correction ===")
    test_labels = [t[0] for t in all_tests]
    raw_pvals = [t[1] for t in all_tests]
    adjusted_pvals = bh_correction(raw_pvals)

    n_sig_005 = sum(1 for p in adjusted_pvals if p < 0.05)
    n_sig_010 = sum(1 for p in adjusted_pvals if p < 0.10)

    bh_results = []
    for i, (label, raw_p) in enumerate(all_tests):
        adj_p = adjusted_pvals[i]
        sig = adj_p < 0.05
        bh_results.append({
            "test": label,
            "raw_p": round(raw_p, 8),
            "bh_adjusted_p": round(adj_p, 8),
            "significant_005": sig,
        })
        marker = "✓" if sig else " "
        print(f"  [{marker}] {label:<30} raw={raw_p:.6f}  adj={adj_p:.6f}")

    print(f"\n  {n_sig_005}/{len(all_tests)} significant at BH α=0.05")
    print(f"  {n_sig_010}/{len(all_tests)} significant at BH α=0.10")

    # === Save output ===
    output = {
        "task": "R11 Q3: 3-verifier canonical BH analysis",
        "generator": "Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3",
        "dataset": "ProofWriter-D5-600",
        "n": n,
        "sc_baseline": {
            "accuracy": round(sc_acc, 4),
            "correct": sc_n_correct,
            "n": n,
            "tiebreaking": "alphabetical",
        },
        "per_verifier": per_verifier_results,
        "ensemble_3verifier": ensemble_results,
        "bh_correction": {
            "n_tests": len(all_tests),
            "method": "Benjamini-Hochberg",
            "all_raw_p": [round(p, 8) for p in raw_pvals],
            "all_adjusted_p": [round(p, 8) for p in adjusted_pvals],
            "n_significant_005": n_sig_005,
            "n_significant_010": n_sig_010,
            "results": bh_results,
        },
    }

    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved: {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Dir-J3: Multi-NLI-Verifier Comparison on ProofWriter-D5 (600 questions).
Compare DeBERTa / RoBERTa / BART NLI verifiers on Mistral-7B SC traces.
"""

import json
import os
import time
from collections import Counter
from scipy.stats import binomtest
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

PW_DATA_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/proofwriter_full.json"
EXP046_PATH = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/exp046_mistral_7b_pw600/exp046_results.json"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/dir_j3_nli_multi_verifier"
CLASSES = ["True", "False", "Unknown"]

MODELS = [
    {"name": "DeBERTa-MNLI", "hf_id": "/root/models/deberta-large-mnli"},
    {"name": "RoBERTa-MNLI", "hf_id": "roberta-large-mnli"},
    {"name": "BART-MNLI",    "hf_id": "facebook/bart-large-mnli"},
]

WEIGHTS = [1, 3, 5]


def parse_problem(problem_text):
    marker = "\n\nDetermine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:\n"
    if marker in problem_text:
        parts = problem_text.split(marker, 1)
        return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
    return problem_text, ""


def map_nli_label(label_str):
    lu = label_str.upper()
    if "ENTAIL" in lu:
        return "True"
    if "CONTRA" in lu:
        return "False"
    return "Unknown"


def run_nli_model(model_name, hf_id, pw_data, gt, device):
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Loading {model_name}: {hf_id}")
    try:
        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(hf_id)
        model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(hf_id)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAILED to load {model_name}: {e}")
        return None

    model.to(device)
    model.eval()

    id2label = model.config.id2label
    nli_to_pw = {idx: map_nli_label(lbl) for idx, lbl in id2label.items()}
    print(f"  id2label: {id2label}")
    print(f"  nli_to_pw: {nli_to_pw}")

    preds = {}
    probs_all = {}
    t0 = time.time()

    for i, q in enumerate(pw_data):
        qid = q["id"]
        premises, conclusion = parse_problem(q["problem"])
        if not conclusion:
            preds[qid] = "Unknown"
            probs_all[qid] = {}
            continue

        inputs = tokenizer(premises, conclusion, return_tensors="pt",
                           truncation=True, max_length=512).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**inputs).logits
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)[0]
        pred_idx = probs.argmax().item()
        preds[qid] = nli_to_pw[pred_idx]
        probs_all[qid] = {nli_to_pw[k]: round(probs[k].item(), 4) for k in id2label}

        if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
            print(f"  {i+1}/{len(pw_data)} done ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"  Inference done: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    correct = sum(1 for qid in gt if preds.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    acc = correct / len(gt)
    print(f"  Standalone accuracy: {acc:.4f} ({correct}/{len(gt)})")

    per_class = {}
    for cls in CLASSES:
        n = sum(1 for qid in gt if gt[qid] == cls)
        c = sum(1 for qid in gt if gt[qid] == cls and preds.get(qid) == cls)
        per_class[cls] = {"n": n, "correct": c, "accuracy": round(c/n, 4) if n > 0 else 0}

    pred_dist = Counter(preds.values())

    return {
        "model_name": model_name,
        "hf_id": hf_id,
        "standalone_accuracy": round(acc, 4),
        "standalone_correct": correct,
        "per_class": per_class,
        "pred_distribution": dict(pred_dist),
        "inference_time_s": round(elapsed, 1),
        "preds": preds,
        "probs": probs_all,
    }


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    print(f"Device: {device}")

    with open(PW_DATA_PATH) as f:
        pw_data = json.load(f)
    with open(EXP046_PATH) as f:
        exp046 = json.load(f)

    gt = {q["id"]: q["answer"] for q in pw_data}
    total = len(gt)
    print(f"Dataset: {total} questions")

    exp046_by_id = {r["problem_id"]: r for r in exp046["results"]}
    sc_answers = {}
    sc_vote_dists = {}
    for qid in gt:
        r = exp046_by_id.get(qid)
        if r:
            sc_answers[qid] = r["sc_answer"]
            sc_vote_dists[qid] = r.get("sc_vote_distribution", {})
        else:
            sc_answers[qid] = None
            sc_vote_dists[qid] = {}

    sc_correct_n = sum(1 for qid in gt if sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    sc_acc = sc_correct_n / total
    print(f"SC baseline: {sc_acc:.4f} ({sc_correct_n}/{total})")

    all_model_results = []

    for m in MODELS:
        result = run_nli_model(m["name"], m["hf_id"], pw_data, gt, device)
        if result is None:
            all_model_results.append({
                "model_name": m["name"], "hf_id": m["hf_id"],
                "status": "FAILED", "error": "model load failed"
            })
            continue

        preds = result["preds"]

        nli_right_sc_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) != gt[qid])
        sc_right_nli_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid] and preds.get(qid) != gt[qid])
        both_right = sum(1 for qid in gt if preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
        both_wrong = total - nli_right_sc_wrong - sc_right_nli_wrong - both_right

        combo_results = {}
        for w in WEIGHTS:
            combo_correct = 0
            b_count = 0
            c_count = 0
            for qid in gt:
                gold = gt[qid]
                votes = Counter()
                dist = sc_vote_dists.get(qid, {})
                for label, count in dist.items():
                    if label in CLASSES:
                        votes[label] += count
                dp = preds.get(qid)
                if dp in CLASSES:
                    votes[dp] += w
                combo_answer = votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else "Unknown"

                if combo_answer == gold:
                    combo_correct += 1
                sc_is_correct = (sc_answers.get(qid) == gold)
                combo_is_correct = (combo_answer == gold)
                if sc_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                    b_count += 1
                if not sc_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                    c_count += 1

            combo_acc = combo_correct / total
            delta = combo_acc - sc_acc
            n_disc = b_count + c_count
            p_val = binomtest(min(b_count, c_count), n_disc, 0.5).pvalue if n_disc > 0 else 1.0

            combo_results[f"w{w}"] = {
                "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
                "correct": combo_correct,
                "delta_vs_sc": round(delta, 4),
                "delta_pp": round(delta * 100, 2),
                "mcnemar_b": b_count,
                "mcnemar_c": c_count,
                "mcnemar_n_discordant": n_disc,
                "mcnemar_p": round(p_val, 6),
            }

        result_entry = {
            "model_name": result["model_name"],
            "hf_id": result["hf_id"],
            "status": "OK",
            "standalone_accuracy": result["standalone_accuracy"],
            "standalone_correct": result["standalone_correct"],
            "per_class": result["per_class"],
            "pred_distribution": result["pred_distribution"],
            "inference_time_s": result["inference_time_s"],
            "complementarity": {
                "nli_right_sc_wrong": nli_right_sc_wrong,
                "sc_right_nli_wrong": sc_right_nli_wrong,
                "both_right": both_right,
                "both_wrong": both_wrong,
            },
            "combo_vs_sc": combo_results,
        }
        all_model_results.append(result_entry)

        print(f"\n  Combo results for {result['model_name']}:")
        for w in WEIGHTS:
            r = combo_results[f"w{w}"]
            print(f"    w={w}: acc={r['accuracy']:.4f}, Δ={r['delta_pp']:+.2f}pp, p={r['mcnemar_p']:.4f}")

    # Summary table
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print("SUMMARY TABLE")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    print(f"SC baseline: {sc_acc:.4f} ({sc_correct_n}/{total})")
    print()
    header = f"{'Verifier':<16} {'w':>3} {'Combo Acc':>10} {'SC Acc':>8} {'Δ (pp)':>8} {'McNemar p':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    for mr in all_model_results:
        if mr.get("status") != "OK":
            print(f"{mr['model_name']:<16}  FAILED: {mr.get('error','')}")
            continue
        for w in WEIGHTS:
            r = mr["combo_vs_sc"][f"w{w}"]
            sig = "*" if r["mcnemar_p"] < 0.05 else ""
            print(f"{mr['model_name']:<16} {w:>3} {r['accuracy']:>10.4f} {sc_acc:>8.4f} {r['delta_pp']:>+8.2f} {r['mcnemar_p']:>9.4f}{sig}")

    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print("STANDALONE NLI ACCURACY")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    for mr in all_model_results:
        if mr.get("status") != "OK":
            continue
        print(f"  {mr['model_name']:<16}: {mr['standalone_accuracy']:.4f}")
        for cls in CLASSES:
            pc = mr['per_class'][cls]
            print(f"    {cls:<10}: {pc['accuracy']:.4f} ({pc['correct']}/{pc['n']})")

    output = {
        "experiment": "dir_j3_nli_multi_verifier",
        "dataset": "ProofWriter-D5-OWA",
        "n_questions": total,
        "sc_baseline": {"accuracy": round(sc_acc, 4), "correct": sc_correct_n},
        "weights_tested": WEIGHTS,
        "device": device,
        "models": all_model_results,
    }

    out_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "results.json")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved: {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
        f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0
        per_class[cls] = {
            "n": n_cls, "correct": tp,
            "accuracy": round(tp / n_cls, 4) if n_cls > 0 else 0,
            "precision": round(p, 4), "recall": round(r, 4), "f1": round(f1, 4)
        }
    print(f"  Per-class: { {c: per_class[c]['accuracy'] for c in CLASSES} }")

    gt_dist = dict(Counter(gt.values()))
    pred_dist = dict(Counter(deberta_preds.values()))

    # === Complementarity analysis ===
    print("\n=== Complementarity ===")
    nli_right_sc_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    sc_right_nli_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid] and deberta_preds.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    both_right = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    both_wrong = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) != gt[qid] and sc_answers.get(qid) != gt[qid])
    print(f"  NLI correct & SC wrong: {nli_right_sc_wrong}")
    print(f"  SC correct & NLI wrong: {sc_right_nli_wrong}")
    print(f"  Both correct: {both_right}")
    print(f"  Both wrong: {both_wrong}")

    # === Combo: DeBERTa vote added to SC votes ===
    print("\n=== Combo (DeBERTa + SC votes) ===")
    combo_results = {}
    for weight in [1, 3]:
        combo_correct = 0
        combo_preds = {}
        # McNemar: b = SC correct & combo wrong, c = SC wrong & combo correct
        b_count = 0
        c_count = 0
        for qid in gt:
            gold = gt[qid]
            dist = sc_vote_dists.get(qid, {})
            votes = Counter()
            for label, count in dist.items():
                if label in CLASSES:
                    votes[label] += count

            dp = deberta_preds.get(qid)
            if dp in CLASSES:
                votes[dp] += weight

            combo_answer = votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else "Unknown"
            combo_preds[qid] = combo_answer

            if combo_answer == gold:
                combo_correct += 1

            sc_is_correct = (sc_answers.get(qid) == gold)
            combo_is_correct = (combo_answer == gold)
            if sc_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                b_count += 1
            if not sc_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                c_count += 1

        combo_acc = combo_correct / total
        delta = combo_acc - sc_acc
        n_disc = b_count + c_count
        p_val = binomtest(min(b_count, c_count), n_disc, 0.5).pvalue if n_disc > 0 else 1.0

        combo_results[weight] = {
            "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
            "correct": combo_correct,
            "delta_vs_sc": round(delta, 4),
            "delta_pp": round(delta * 100, 2),
            "mcnemar_b": b_count,
            "mcnemar_c": c_count,
            "mcnemar_n_discordant": n_disc,
            "mcnemar_p": round(p_val, 6)
        }
        sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else ""
        print(f"  w={weight}: acc={combo_acc:.4f} ({combo_correct}/{total}), "
              f"delta={delta:+.4f} ({delta*100:+.2f}pp), "
              f"McNemar b={b_count} c={c_count} p={p_val:.4f} {sig}")

    print(f"\n  SC baseline: {sc_acc:.4f}")
    print(f"  SICA baseline: {sica_acc:.4f}")

    # === SICA combo ===
    print("\n=== Bonus: SICA combo ===")
    sica_combo_results = {}
    for weight in [1, 3]:
        sica_combo_correct = 0
        b_s = 0
        c_s = 0
        for qid in gt:
            gold = gt[qid]
            dist = sc_vote_dists.get(qid, {})
            votes = Counter()
            for label, count in dist.items():
                if label in CLASSES:
                    votes[label] += count
            dp = deberta_preds.get(qid)
            if dp in CLASSES:
                votes[dp] += weight
            combo_answer = votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else "Unknown"
            if combo_answer == gold:
                sica_combo_correct += 1
            sica_is_correct = (sica_answers.get(qid) == gold)
            combo_is_correct = (combo_answer == gold)
            if sica_is_correct and not combo_is_correct:
                b_s += 1
            if not sica_is_correct and combo_is_correct:
                c_s += 1
        sica_combo_acc = sica_combo_correct / total
        sica_delta = sica_combo_acc - sica_acc
        n_disc_s = b_s + c_s
        p_val_s = binomtest(min(b_s, c_s), n_disc_s, 0.5).pvalue if n_disc_s > 0 else 1.0
        sica_combo_results[weight] = {
            "accuracy": round(sica_combo_acc, 4),
            "delta_vs_sica": round(sica_delta, 4),
            "mcnemar_b": b_s, "mcnemar_c": c_s, "mcnemar_p": round(p_val_s, 6)
        }
        print(f"  w={weight} vs SICA: acc={sica_combo_acc:.4f}, delta={sica_delta:+.4f}, p={p_val_s:.4f}")

    # === DeBERTa vs SICA agreement ===
    print("\n=== DeBERTa vs SICA agreement ===")
    sica_agree = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == sica_answers.get(qid))
    sica_disagree = total - sica_agree
    sica_agree_correct = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) == sica_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    sica_disagree_deberta = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) != sica_answers.get(qid) and deberta_preds.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    sica_disagree_sica = sum(1 for qid in gt if deberta_preds.get(qid) != sica_answers.get(qid) and sica_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid])
    print(f"  Agreement: {sica_agree/total:.4f} ({sica_agree}/{total})")
    if sica_agree > 0:
        print(f"  Agree accuracy: {sica_agree_correct/sica_agree:.4f}")
    print(f"  Disagree: DeBERTa right={sica_disagree_deberta}, SICA right={sica_disagree_sica}")

    # Save results
    results = {
        "dataset": "ProofWriter-D5-OWA",
        "n_questions": total,
        "model": MODEL_NAME,
        "deberta_standalone": {
            "accuracy": round(deberta_acc, 4),
            "correct": deberta_correct_n, "total": total,
            "per_class": per_class,
            "gt_distribution": gt_dist,
            "pred_distribution": pred_dist,
            "inference_time_s": round(elapsed, 1)
        },
        "baselines": {"sc": round(sc_acc, 4), "sica": round(sica_acc, 4)},
        "complementarity": {
            "nli_right_sc_wrong": nli_right_sc_wrong,
            "sc_right_nli_wrong": sc_right_nli_wrong,
            "both_right": both_right,
            "both_wrong": both_wrong
        },
        "combo_vs_sc": {
            f"w{w}": combo_results[w] for w in [1, 3]
        },
        "combo_vs_sica": {
            f"w{w}": sica_combo_results[w] for w in [1, 3]
        },
        "deberta_sica_agreement": {
            "agree": sica_agree, "disagree": sica_disagree,
            "agree_accuracy": round(sica_agree_correct / sica_agree, 4) if sica_agree > 0 else 0,
            "disagree_deberta_correct": sica_disagree_deberta,
            "disagree_sica_correct": sica_disagree_sica
        },
        "per_question": {
            qid: {
                "deberta_pred": deberta_preds[qid],
                "deberta_probs": deberta_probs[qid],
                "sc_answer": sc_answers.get(qid),
                "sica_answer": sica_answers.get(qid),
                "gold": gt[qid],
                "deberta_correct": deberta_preds[qid] == gt[qid],
                "sc_correct": sc_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid],
                "sica_correct": sica_answers.get(qid) == gt[qid]
            }
            for qid in gt
        }
    }

    out = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "results.json")
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved: {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
